stem.text: $X$ is a non-cyclic ketone with a single carbonyl group and no other functional groups. Ketone $X$ has the following properties.

items: When ketone $X$ is treated with $\text{NaBH}_4$, the organic product has a $M_\text{r}$ 2.3256% greater than the $M_\text{r}$ of ketone $X$.
Ketone $X$ gives a yellow precipitate with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$.

stem.text: How many isomeric ketones could be ketone $X$?
